filename: Cloud chamber constraints on depositional ice growth models .pdf
title: Cloud chamber constraints on depositional ice growth models
parameterization_target: depositional ice growth kinetics (deposition coefficient / critical supersaturation)
host_model: Diffusion Surface Kinetics Ice Crystal Evolution (DiSKICE)
testbed_rationale: Conference abstract without links or access statements to the model code or AIDA chamber dataset.
pain_points: Physics of depositional ice growth at low temperatures (<235 K) is poorly constrained.
Unexplained discrepancies among experimental measurements of ice deposition coefficients.
Deviations between experimental cloud chamber observations and depositional growth models at cold temperatures.
extraction_notes: Conference abstract for AGU Fall Meeting 2023. Discusses progress towards Bayesian parameter estimation using MCMC and the DiSKICE bin microphysics model.
